verses.uhibbu-jamala-l-lahi-fi-kulli-khalqihi-c: ʾuḥibbu jamāla llāhi fī kulli khalqihi walawlā jamālu llāhi mā t-tadhdha ʿāqilu
wujūhu ḥisānu lā ʾuḥibbu firāqahā waʾalfāẓu durri ṣīgha minhā sh-shamāʾilu
waʾin lam yakun yaḥyā bihadhī qulūbukum faqalbī bihā yaḥyā waʾin qāla qāʾilu
waʾaṣnāfu dhulli wāḥtimāli wariqqahi waʿaqliyyatu yarḍā bihā min yusāʾilu
